name: What should I look for during a new construction home inspection?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for during a new construction home inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a new construction home inspection, it's crucial to look for structural integrity, proper system installations (HVAC, plumbing, electrical), and quality of finishes. Even new homes can have deficiencies. A practical tradeoff is balancing the cost of a private inspection against the peace of mind it provides beyond the builder's internal checks. An independent inspector can identify issues the builder's warranty might not cover or that could become costly problems down the road, making it a valuable investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: During a new construction inspection, check structural integrity, system installations, and finishes. An independent inspection offers peace of mind beyond builder checks, identifying potential issues.
